chapters.title: Why one password is not enough
SMS, authenticator apps and passkeys compared

takeaways: A second factor only adds security if it comes from a different category of proof than your password.
Text-message codes beat no MFA, authenticator apps with number matching are stronger, and security keys or passkeys are the only widely available phishing-resistant option.
Roll MFA out in stages, protect admin and finance accounts first, enroll backup methods and recovery codes, and keep watching the sign-in logs.
hook: Most break-ins start with a password that has already leaked, and many people turn on MFA with the weakest second step. This episode explains factors, compares SMS, authenticator apps and passkeys, and shows individuals and IT teams how to roll out MFA without lockouts or push-bombing surprises.
